verdict.rationale: Linear's first-party GitHub integration names issue sync directly ('sync issues'), and the changelog refers to 'GitHub-synced' issues, so the product does sync tasks with a code repository's issue tracker. The evidence never says the sync is bi-directional, and nothing documents how fields, status or comments propagate. missing for 10: explicit documentation of two-way sync, field/status/comment mapping details, coverage of other repo trackers (e.g. GitLab issues), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data

citations.quote: Connect GitHub to automate PR workflows, review code in Linear, sync issues and understand your codebase with Linear Agent
